description: This file contains a jQuery.UI.iPad plugin that enables touch interactions, including simulating mouse events like click, dblclick, mousedown, mouseup, and contextmenu for iPad and iPhone devices. It manages touch gestures and emulates right-click functionality through event simulation.

methods.name: cancelTap
methods.description: Prevents a double tap detection by setting tapValid to false.

methods.name: cancelHold
methods.description: Cancels the hold timeout and resets right-click pending state.

methods.name: startHold
methods.description: Initiates a hold timeout for potential right-click emulation.

methods.name: doRightClick
methods.description: Simulates a right-click context menu via dispatching mouse events.

methods.name: iPadTouchStart
methods.description: Handles touch start events, mimicking mouse over and mousedown events, managing tap/double-tap logic.

methods.name: getDOMElementFromEvent
methods.description: Retrieves the DOM element under the touch point.

methods.name: iPadTouchHandler
methods.description: Main handler for touch events, dispatching corresponding mouse events and managing gesture logic.
